target_customer: Retailers in Europe and the United States that need to plan purchases and reorder stock
problem: Retailers carry too much stock or run out. Metreecs forecasts demand with a mix of over 30 statistical and machine learning models and automates replenishment and reallocation.
product_category: Retail demand forecasting and inventory optimization

founders.name: Thibaut Pellegrin
previous_startups: Leather bag company (co-founded, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: consulting and growth equity focused on B2B SaaS.

founders.name: Martin Dimitrov
founders.background_notes: YC page: led Lydia's expansion in Italy, then early stage VC in AI and B2B SaaS.

founders.name: Elie Dufeu
founders.background_notes: YC page: built forecasting models for financial institutions.

technical_complexity.rationale: Forecasting at SKU and store level with ensembles of models is established practice, with hard parts in data integration across retailer systems.

defensibility.rationale: Established vendors (RELEX, Lokad, Afresh) already served retail forecasting, so differentiation rests on AI automation and ease of deployment; ERP integration creates some switching costs once live.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Planning vendors and ERP suites already sold forecasting, but no source shows them copying or buying Metreecs.

market_need_then: Overstock and stockouts are costly for retailers; the company reports cutting inventory by up to 15 percent and raising turnover by up to 5 percent (company claims, unverified).

branding.domain_note: Uses metreecs.com; no purchase history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and outcome focused with headlines like Deploy AI-Native Systems Today and bold ROI claims.

brand_strength.rationale: Spelling is hard to guess and no source covers the brand itself; funding news carried more visibility than the name.

outcome_analysis: Metreecs, a Paris based team in YC's Fall 2024 batch, announced a seed round of about 2.7 million euros in October 2025 from YC, Kima Ventures, Bpifrance, Monte Carlo Capital and Founders Future, alongside a launch in Italy. It claims European and US customers without naming them. It is early, so no strong outcome or failure can be assigned.
notes: The seed amount is 2.7M EUR per Startupbusiness (October 2, 2025), reported as about 2.0M USD by Signalbase and 3.2M USD by an aggregator; no USD figure is stated by the primary report, so amount_usd is left null. Aggregators also list an earlier 500K USD round in December 2024 and totals between 2.3M EUR and 3.66M USD, all unverified. Competitor search returned CB Insights and vendor lists with no dated entries near the batch, so none are recorded as of founding. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. YC batch is Fall 2024.
